_meta.purpose: Hand-curated top-up for multi-ZIP cities that GeoNames under-covers. Merged over the GeoNames base by scripts/build-data.mjs (deduped by zip+cityMunCode).
sources: Wikipedia 'ZIP codes in the Philippines' (lists Davao City as 8000 + 8016–8026)
notes: Entries are keyed by exact PSGC cityMunCode (NOT name) to avoid the Calamba/Samal name ambiguity.
area is left null where a reliable ZIP->district mapping could not be confidently sourced — the city-level assignment is the verified claim.
province/region are derived from the cityMunCode via @ph-dev-utils/core at build time.
